mobs.name: Mailer Daemon
mobs.flavor: MAILER-DAEMON says your message bounced. Click here to retry. You never sent one.
mobs.abilityText: When it enters play or comes back, roll for the persistence row. Anything that roll brings back rolls for the row too.

mobs.name: Macro Gremlin
mobs.flavor: invoice_FINAL_v2.docm lands in your queue. It really, really wants you to click Enable Content.
mobs.abilityText: Only the analyst on point takes its damage, doubled.

mobs.name: Password Sprayer
mobs.flavor: Summer2026! tries every account in the tower, one a minute. It only needs one to work.

mobs.name: MFA Banshee
mobs.flavor: A phone upstairs buzzes for the ninth time. It will wail until someone half asleep taps Approve.
mobs.abilityText: It only hits the analyst with the lowest HP.

mobs.name: Vibe Coded App
mobs.flavor: You open the app that shipped Friday. The API keys are in the frontend, and auth is a vibe.
mobs.abilityText: +1 damage every round it stays up.

mobs.name: PowerShell Wraith
mobs.flavor: A window flashes -nop -w hidden -enc JABzAD0A… and is gone. You check the disk. Nothing touched it.

mobs.name: Living-off-the-Land Scavenger
mobs.flavor: Rundll32, mshta, certutil: every tool it runs is yours. It lives off what already grows here.
mobs.abilityText: Only a natural 12 or higher can hit it.

mobs.name: DNS Beacon Drone
mobs.flavor: You hear it before you see it: 4,000 queries to random subdomains. Echolocation.
mobs.abilityText: When it enters play or comes back, roll for the persistence row. Anything that roll brings back rolls for the row too.

mobs.name: OAuth Consent Grifter
mobs.flavor: A friendly pop-up asks if this app may read all your mail. Someone’s thumb is already on Accept.
mobs.abilityText: Only the analyst on point takes its damage, doubled.

mobs.name: Rootkit Implant
mobs.flavor: You count the svchost.exe processes twice. One looks exactly right, and it has teeth.
mobs.abilityText: Heals 1 hit at the end of each round.

mobs.name: Kerberoast Enforcer
mobs.flavor: You smell it in the logs first: service tickets, roasting slowly over an RC4 fire.

mobs.name: LSASS Siphon
mobs.flavor: Someone ran comsvcs.dll MiniDump on the domain controller. It’s feeding on credentials.
mobs.abilityText: Heals 1 hit at the end of each round.

mobs.name: PsExec Swarm
mobs.flavor: You remove one PsExec service. Two more install before you’ve closed the ticket.
mobs.abilityText: When it enters play or comes back, roll for the persistence row. Anything that roll brings back rolls for the row too.

mobs.name: Golden Ticket Ghost
mobs.flavor: The ticket was forged with the KRBTGT hash. It’s valid for ten years, and it’s already inside.
mobs.abilityText: Only a natural 12 or higher can hit it.

mobs.name: Exfil Courier
mobs.flavor: rclone.exe is moving 40 GB to a cloud bucket you’ve never seen. It’s still small. For now.
mobs.abilityText: +1 damage every round it stays up.

bosses.name: The Lockjaw Syndicate
bosses.abilityText: +2 damage until it has taken two hits. At the end of every round it’s still up, roll for the row.

bosses.name: The Persistent Operator
bosses.abilityText: The first time you beat it, it comes back with 2 hits left. Every double that hits it rolls for the row.

bosses.name: The Rogue AI
bosses.abilityText: Agents can’t roll while it’s in play. Burning one rolls for the row.

situations.name: Impossible Travel
situations.text: Marketing just signed in from Lisbon, ten minutes after badging in downstairs. You’re on point: make the call.
situations.rule: On point: roll 10+ in one attempt. Pass: draw a kit card. Fail: you lose 2 HP.

situations.name: Coffee Run
situations.text: Someone braves the rain and comes back with a tray of cold brew. Morale stabilizes.

situations.name: Marketing Blast
situations.text: Ten thousand inboxes, one link, and your mail filter is screaming.

opts.label: On point takes it alone: they lose 3 HP

situations.name: Patch Tuesday
situations.text: The patches deploy and the tower goes quiet. You get a window. Use it.

opts.label: Take a breather: everyone heals 2 HP
Raid the supply locker: draw a kit card

situations.name: CISO Wants a Briefing
situations.text: Your phone lights up: the CISO wants five slides in ten minutes. With questions.
situations.rule: On point: roll 12+ in one attempt. Fail: you lose 4 HP.

situations.name: Threat Intel Drop
situations.text: A partner sends indicators for something you already beat. For once, you’re ahead.
situations.rule: Discard one mob from the persistence row.

situations.name: Pentest Day
situations.text: Someone in a hi-vis vest is in the server room. The red team is in the building, and nobody told you.
situations.rule: Everyone rolls once. Anyone under 8 loses 2 HP.

situations.name: Pager Storm
situations.text: Four hundred alerts land in four minutes, and every phone on the floor goes off. Everyone is awake now.
situations.rule: Everyone loses 2 HP. On point loses 2 more.

situations.name: Budget Approved
situations.text: An email from Finance lands in the dead of night: approved. Nobody knows why, and you don’t ask.

situations.name: The Badge That Wasn’t
situations.text: A badge swipes into the server room at 03:10. Its owner left on Friday. You’re on point: find out who’s holding it.
situations.rule: On point: roll 12+ in one attempt. Fail: you lose 4 HP and roll for the row.
situations.reconText: You pulled the badge logs at 22:00. Skip the roll and draw a kit card.

situations.name: Lateral Whispers
situations.text: Logons hop from host to host, one every ninety seconds. Something you beat is looking for a way back in.
situations.rule: Roll for the row now. Anything that comes back, you fight after this.
situations.reconText: You mapped the path first. Discard one mob from the persistence row instead.

situations.name: The CEO’s Inbox
situations.text: A wire request sits in the CEO’s inbox, signed with her name. She’s on a plane. It’s due by 04:00.

opts.label: Let it ride: the next mob you flip gets +2 Damage

situations.reconText: You flagged the sender an hour ago. No cost, and draw a kit card.

situations.name: Ghost in the Change Window
situations.text: A firewall rule changed at 01:00. There’s no ticket, and the account that made it doesn’t exist.
situations.rule: The next mob you flip has +3 Defense.
situations.reconText: You read the change before it landed. The next mob has −3 Defense instead.

situations.name: Dark Web Chatter
situations.text: Your company’s name turns up on a forum at 02:30, next to a price. Someone is selling a way in.
situations.reconText: You know what they’re selling. Draw two kit cards.

situations.name: The Janitor’s USB
situations.text: A USB stick sits on the break-room table, labelled SALARIES 2026. Three people have already plugged it in.
situations.rule: Everyone rolls once. Anyone under 10 loses 3 HP.
situations.reconText: You blocked removable media at the last change window. Nobody rolls.

situations.name: Old Case, New IOC
situations.text: A partner sends a hash from a case you closed in March. It’s running on a laptop on the fourth floor.
situations.rule: The mob in the row with the widest range comes back now, with no arrival hit. Fight it after this.
situations.reconText: You kept the case open. Discard that mob from the row for good instead.

situations.name: Honeytoken Tripped
situations.text: The fake admin password you planted in 2024 just got used. Now you know exactly where they are.
situations.reconText: You were watching the trap. Everyone heals 3 HP, and draw a kit card.

situations.name: Vendor Breach Notice
situations.text: An email from your payroll vendor lands at 04:12: they were breached in June. They’re telling you now.
situations.rule: Everyone loses 2 HP. Then roll for the row.
situations.reconText: You rotated their keys in the spring. Nothing happens.

classes.agent: Hunt Agents hunt with you: a comeback they finish is gone for good too.

tips.1: Everyone rolls at once. Put each die on a mob it beats: d20 + bonus, at least its Defense. Anything still standing hits back. Stalker: the Banshee only goes after whoever is lowest.
tips.2: The Banshee came back. Beaten mobs wait in the persistence row, and every flip rolls for them. It hit everyone for 1 on the way in. The card comes first, then you fight it again.
tips.3: Targeted: only whoever is on point takes the Gremlin's damage, and it's doubled. Pick on point with that in mind.
tips.4: A challenge: the analyst on point gets one roll. Bonuses count.
tips.5: Beacon: the Drone rolls for the persistence row the moment it shows up, and anything it calls back rolls again. Comebacks return at full strength and hit everyone on the way in.
tips.6: A breather before the boss. Heal up and check your kit.
tips.loot: Kit drop. Every kit card is an agent: keep it running, or burn it once for a big one-shot effect.
tips.boss: The boss. Its hits grow with your crew, and agents can't touch it. Burn what you've got.
